From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novahealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — owner alignment & staging dependencies

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I’m sending a concise owner-level MAP draft and the minimal staging dependency table so we can lock responsibilities and dates this week. High-level asks below: 

- Confirm who owns each milestone on your side (single point of contact per milestone).
- Call out any hard constraints in May–June (vacations, procurement freezes, cloud approvals).
- Accept the proposed cutover window for the pilot (week of 2027-07-12) or propose an alternative.

Attached: MAP_v1.pdf (draft), staging-deps-table.csv (dev/infra dependencies), acceptance-criteria.md (what counts as "pilot complete").

Proposed internal owners (we can reassign):
- Integration & ETL: Marcus Lin
- Trial configuration & prompts: Lauren Bishop
- Go-live coordination & CS handoff: Monica Patel

Next steps: if you can reply with owners + any blocking items by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-18), we’ll produce a final MAP and schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,
Priyom
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]
[Attachment: staging-deps-table.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — owner alignment & staging dependencies

Priyom —

Appreciate the clear doc. Quick answers from our side: 

- Owners:
  - Data extraction & SFTP handoff: Tom Hsu (tom.hsu@novahealth.com)
  - Mapping/Transform validation: Lena Ortiz (primary) / Micah Reyes (backup)
  - Security review & SOC evidence: Sarah Kim (security) — she’s out 5/20–5/28 but can do a pre-review next Tues

- Hard constraints: procurement is closed 5/24–5/28 (Memorial week), and our cloud team has a scheduled upgrade on 6/04 that could reduce availability for a day.

- Pilot cutover: the week of 2027-07-12 works for us but we need the sandbox environment provisioned by 2027-06-21 to allow two weeks of integration testing.

I’ll upload a revised dependency column with Sarah’s dates. Minor ask: can you split the staging-deps-table.csv into infra vs data items? Makes tracking easier for our teams.

Thanks — will coordinate internally and confirm owners by EOD Tues.

—Lena
Director, Product Ops — NovaHealth

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novahealth.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@novahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — owner alignment & staging dependencies

Thanks Lena — noted. A couple of operational clarifications from the infra side: 

1) Sandbox provisioning: We can meet the 2027-06-21 target if NovaHealth approves the infra template by 2027-05-21. Approval means one of your infra leads signs off on the template in the Drive link.

2) Staging split: I’ll take the infra rows and Monica will take data/ETL rows. Monica / Lauren — I’ve added expected owners and an initial estimate of work (hours) in the staging-deps-table.csv column "redwood_estimate"; please review and flag anything that looks low.

3) Acceptance criteria: I added a pass/fail checklist to acceptance-criteria.md — most important item for pilot success is a deterministic latency baseline for typical queries (p95 < 450ms). If the latency target needs relaxing because of corpus size, flag it here and we’ll propose tuned batching/quantization profiles.

I’ll produce an updated MAP after the owners are confirmed.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Inline: excerpt from staging-deps-table.csv (infra rows assigned)]

Hi everyone —

Great progress — summarizing agreed items and owners below so there’s no ambiguity when we move to the final MAP: 

- Sandbox provisioning sign-off: NovaHealth infra (action: Tom Hsu) — sign-off by 2027-05-21 required.
- Sandbox live target: 2027-06-21 (Redwood infra + Nova test account)
- Integration testing window: 2027-06-22 → 2027-07-06
- Pilot cutover: week of 2027-07-12 (target 2027-07-14)

Assigned owners (final):
- Integration / ETL validation: Tom Hsu (NovaHealth) + Monica Patel (Redwood)
- Mapping and prompts: Lena Ortiz (NovaHealth) + Lauren Bishop (Redwood)
- Security & compliance sign-off: Sarah Kim (NovaHealth) — pre-review by 2027-05-25, final evidence by 2027-06-18
- CS handoff & success metrics: Monica Patel — acceptance criteria documented in acceptance-criteria.md

Open risks / asks:
- Procurement freeze (5/24–5/28) — may delay any required purchase orders for additional staging capacity.
- Cloud upgrade (6/04) — Redwood will run a short smoke test with a reduced worker pool on that day; Nova to confirm there are no planned deployments that day.

I attached a one-page owner slate (MAP_v1.pdf) with the dates above and a clean column for sign-off. Please reply-all with confirmations (owner + "I sign off") by EOD Monday 2027-05-24 so we can convert this into the official MAP and lock the kickoff invite.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Product — Redwood Inference
